critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Landing gear (nose gear + 4-truck main gear) when visible' (mean 2.19/10). Target the 8 anchor: nose gear plus four main-gear trucks under the wing/body junction with wheels; then the 10 anchor: recognizable 747 gear layout: two-wheel nose strut, four multi-wheel main bogies (two under the body, two under the wings), plausible strut lengths.
